title: Hypixel SkyBlock Fancy Panes
description: NotEnoughUpdates' Fancy Panes in Modern Hypixel SkyBlock
body:
# Fancy Panes

Adds [NotEnoughUpdates](https://modrinth.com/mod/notenoughupdates)' Fancy Panes from the Storage Overlay into your Storage, without requiring an overwhelming overlay.

**Requires [Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)**

---

### Feature(s)
- Connecting (Stained) Glass Panes of the same color together, without connecting to other colors.
- Customizable color (including alpha) for Glass Panes.

---

Planned for the Future:
- Toggle for just EnderChest/Backpacks, Island (Large) Chests, any container.
- More Styles.
